notes.title: Week 2: First update
notes.content:

- the rest of repetition subjects
- option to leave using word "leave"
- button "Glimpsing timer" that allows you to change timer of Glimpsing Tests
- setting "Notice Off" - related to experimental way to reduce loading times
- Personal Data | Glimpsing (with experimental way of functioning)
- more options in item "Options"

 [u]Changed[/u]
- music volume on Letters' page
- icon used to "leave"
- nerfed "Lost-in-Woods"
- Leon's position after changing characters
- window position of Letters / Colors / Numbers (Randomized) to match the others | I cannot change Letters Glimpsing for now
- names of choices in "Correction Off" to be more transparent

 [u]Bugs[/u]

- displaying wrong word in Months -> Roman
- gray option "Paper too bright" wasn't working properly
- changing "Paper too bright" option in overworld was changing whole map
- Sophia stayed downstairs after one way of entering to house

 [u]Deleted[/u]
- one stack of papers laying on the table

 [u]Notes[/u]
- testing a way to reduce time to load Page 1 and 2 (experiment available on Page 2)
